answer: Every finished job enters a violet audit pool where three strangers re-score it blind; a vertex whose grades always match its reviewers gets flagged, and two flags in one epoch trigger a full audit. Reviewers who rubber-stamp lose 10 reputation points per bad call, so a farm running 50 clones must bribe a fresh jury each time, and its yarrow of rubber-stamped approvals withers under audit: each clone costs 40 units to insure.
